result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and pedestrian signals. However, the environment lacks advanced safety features like curb extensions or refuge islands, leaving pedestrians exposed over a moderate crossing distance.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island for protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to allow pedestrians to enter the crosswalk before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a mixed-use urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, zebra-marked crosswalks, and signalization. While essential features are present, the environment is degraded by faded pavement markings and a lack of daylighting at the corners, which may compromise visibility.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may obstruct sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven pavement within the crossing area could present a tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway within the crosswalk area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to ensure they are clearly seen by drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The image depicts a typical urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, traffic signals, and curb ramps. However, safety is compromised by faded crosswalk markings and significant visual obstructions caused by vehicles parked close to the intersection corners.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions (Daylighting)
hazards.description: Parked vehicles, including a large delivery van, are positioned right at the intersection, blocking sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Curb sides adjacent to the crosswalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk and a marked continental crosswalk at an unsignalized intersection. However, the lack of a pedestrian refuge island and the significant crossing distance across the wide roadway increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed for a significant duration while crossing the wide roadway without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, the width of the roadway at the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of active signalization
hazards.description: The crossing is marked but lacks signals or warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.
